use std::future::Future;
use std::pin::Pin;
use std::task::{Context, Poll, RawWaker, RawWakerVTable, Waker};

pub async fn plain(x: u32) -> u32 {
    if x > 1 {
        x + 1
    } else {
        x
    }
}

pub async fn with_block(x: u32) -> u32 {
    let b = async { x + 1 };
    let c = |v: u32| v * 2;
    let d = async move { c(x) + 1 };
    b.await + d.await + c(1)
}

pub fn returns_block(x: u32) -> impl Future<Output = u32> {
    async move { if x > 1 { x } else { 0 } }
}

pub fn run<F: Future>(mut f: F) -> F::Output {
    fn noop(_: *const ()) {}
    fn clone(_: *const ()) -> RawWaker { RawWaker::new(std::ptr::null(), &VT) }
    static VT: RawWakerVTable = RawWakerVTable::new(clone, noop, noop, noop);
    let w = unsafe { Waker::from_raw(RawWaker::new(std::ptr::null(), &VT)) };
    let mut cx = Context::from_waker(&w);
    let mut f = unsafe { Pin::new_unchecked(&mut f) };
    loop { if let Poll::Ready(v) = f.as_mut().poll(&mut cx) { return v; } }
}

#[test]
fn t() {
    assert!(run(plain(2)) > 0);
    assert!(run(with_block(2)) > 0);
    assert!(run(returns_block(2)) > 0);
}
